newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Balongan refinery unit needs three weeks to repair.
newsitem.headline: Balongan refinery unit needs three weeks to repair.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Tuesday its residue unit at its Balongan refinery needs three weeks for repairs following an unexpected technical problem.

"There is small technical problem at residue catalytic cracker (RCC) at the Balongan refinery. We need three weeks to repair the RCC," Samto Utomo, junior processing director at Pertamina, told Reuters.
Pertamina did not reveal the exact nature of the problem. The company closed the 83,000-barrels-per-day (bpd) RCC on February 6.
Utomo said attempts to restart the unit on February 20 had failed because of what he only described as "another small problem."
He said there was no plan to shut down the 125,000-bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) at the refinery.
"All units are fine except the RCC. The CDU is running at 70 percent of its capacity at the moment. We have no plan to shutdown the CDU this time because it has no problems," he said.
